title: Reducing packets
checked_scope: A finite orthogonal idempotent resolution with zero off-diagonal generator blocks commutes with the generator; actual exponential cross blocks vanish and compressed dynamics agree with the exponential of the compressed generator.

title: Exact Duhamel refinement identity
checked_scope: Bochner interval-integral identity for rectangular bounded real operators on Banach spaces, and exact intertwining.

title: Norm bound
checked_scope: The displayed exponential-growth integral estimate for rectangular bounded real operators, with the contraction specialization.

title: Resolvent refinement identity
checked_scope: Literal rectangular matrices with left/right inverse equations and central scalar; applies to the stated resolvents.

title: Finite Markov semigroup
checked_scope: The actual real matrix exponential of any finite generator has nonnegative entries and columns summing to one for nonnegative time; consequently it preserves probability vectors.

title: Exact lumpability
checked_scope: Literal rectangular matrix intertwining for every natural-number iterate.

title: Finite-horizon defect formula
checked_scope: The literal rectangular finite-sum defect identity and the norm bound for arbitrary rectangular contractions, including horizon zero and zero spaces.

title: Finite conditional-expectation projector
checked_scope: Literal finite complex weighted conditional expectation: idempotence, self-adjointness for the weighted inner product, and range exactly the block-constant functions. Strictly positive finite weights are explicit.

title: Tower law and martingale packets
checked_scope: Both concrete conditional-expectation tower identities; arbitrary pairs of nested projector kernels multiply to the coarser kernel; their differences are pairwise orthogonal idempotents and sum to the terminal projector.

title: Independent-likelihood composition
checked_scope: Composition with explicit nonzero first and combined evidences; positive evidences imply these hypotheses.

title: Bayesian packet reconstruction
checked_scope: Literal finite fibers and evidence-weighted reconstruction, including zero-evidence packets; specialize nonnegative weights to likelihood times prior.

title: Likelihood perturbation bound
checked_scope: The printed finite weighted L1 perturbation bound under nonnegativity and positive evidence.

title: Exact effective-likelihood factorization
checked_scope: Literal finite coarsening and prior-dependent effective likelihood, including zero prior-mass fibers.

title: Bayesian refinement criterion
checked_scope: The all-prior equivalence for strictly positive fine and coarse likelihoods and a surjective partition with at least two packets; necessity is derived from actual two-state priors. Singleton coarsening is automatic.

title: Bayesian information-loss packet
checked_scope: The literal information-loss matrix factorization, null scale direction, minimum-evidence L1 estimate, and the final fine-to-coarse weighted bound, including zero prior-mass fibers.

title: Nested Bayesian packet tower
checked_scope: The necessary-and-sufficient adjacent likelihood criterion with singleton exception, and exact Bayesian commutation over every finite span of a varying-state-space tower.

title: Canonical coarsest likelihood-resolving partition
checked_scope: Actual quotient by equality of likelihood profiles, canonical coarse likelihoods and exact closure, unique factorization from every likelihood-resolving partition, and the corrected coarsest nontrivial all-prior-closed property under strict positivity and distinct profiles.

title: Bayesian nonlinear semigroup
checked_scope: Actual normalized real exponential flow on the finite probability simplex, its semigroup law, and centered multiplicative derivative.

title: Prediction-update reconstruction
checked_scope: Literal column-stochastic matrix prediction followed by a nonnegative positive-evidence Bayesian update.

checked_scope: Fractional powers and transfer for the given finite spectral resolution, including zero eigenvalues; multiplication/addition laws, packet reduction, and identification with the actual algebra exponential. Finite spectral resolution is the stated starting data.
